recommendations.notes: Sfredo & Borkert (1993) via Embrapa Soja. N=0 universal (FBN). P 40-50, K 70 for medium soil.
recommendations.soilContext: Soil P 3.1-6.0 mg/dm3; K 0.11-0.20 cmolc/dm3 (Paraná table)

recommendations.notes: Embrapa Soja FBN rule confirmed. Cerrado P/K table not verified — do NOT use PR rates here.
Raij et al. 1996 via Embrapa. N 30-50 in furrow; P/K by soil test x yield target.
Raij et al. 1996: 70-180 kg N/ha topdress by yield target (2-12 t/ha).
Embrapa practice example: 200 kg/ha 4-20-20 + 60 kg/ha urea topdress. Working range N 30-90.
Raij et al. 1996 (IAC). +30-60 N topdress (quebra-lombo). Plant cane is N-unresponsive; high P/K at planting.
Raij et al. 1996. Ratoon: higher N and K, much lower P than plant cane.
5ª Aproximação via EMATER-MG. Fertilize Sep-Mar (rainy season). N 6.2 kg/bag rule of thumb.
